<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex11152024-09-0412-06-12" status="finalized" ana="corpusmd:colophon"><milestone unit="section" n="Colophon (26a7–26b2)"/><rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4544">rten cing 'brel par 'byung <expan>ba'i</expan> rab tu byed pa | 
            'khor 'das kyi chos <expan>thams cad</expan> blta' ba'i me long</rs> zhes bya ba 'di ni | 
            lung rigs <lb n="26a8"/> kyi gzhung 'grel mang du thos shing legs par sbyangs pas tshul <expan>bzhin</expan> du rtogs shing | 
            <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3854">rigs par smra ba'i btsun pa blo gros seng ghe</rs>s | 
            <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:6812">dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsod <pb n="16b"/><lb n="26b1"/> nams 'bum</rs> gyi don du | 
            nye bar sbyar pas 'di re shig yongs su rdzogs s+ho || <note type="gloss"><expan>zhus so</expan></note></seg></TEI>
